summary: Provider-mode Verify selects gates (routing, owners, maturity, inherited floors) from the workspace's own Governance catalog under .fsgg. Each required capability id must be the id of a gate that the verify scope routes to; otherwise planning refuses with exit 3, and the refusal now names the catalog. Governance never derives gates from provider provenance or declarations, because that would let provider data create its own floors. A workspace scaffolded through the SDD catalog provider route gets no Governance overlay, so SDD#928 C3.1-03 had to hand-write a minimal catalog (domain test, check test, gate test:test). Supplying that catalog at creation belongs to workspace composition: Templates#441 and the SDD scaffold composition under GOV-423-C4 and SDD928-C4. It is not part of Verify. Until then, qualification journeys must add a catalog that is independent of the provider fixture and disclose it.
title: Provider-mode Verify needs the workspace's own Governance .fsgg catalog
